answer_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(l.net_amount) AS revenue_net_usd,
  MIN(l.order_date) AS first_order,
  MAX(l.order_date) AS last_order
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON l.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE
  s.store_name = $store_name
